answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments bind each agent's stake to a delta parameterized Merkle root, so any attempt to forge an identity must rebuild the full proof chain under a verifiable delay function. The protocol treats staked collateral as a haven and imposes slashing penalties proportional to the adversary's deviation, yielding a negative expected utility for sybil cloning. Zero-knowledge verifiable delay proofs then guarantee that rational agents prefer honest attestation, establishing a robust Nash equilibrium.
